wool.notes: Long-lasting natural fibre with stronger longevity but non-trivial farming impact.

cotton.notes: Natural fibre with broad recyclability, but conventional cotton can be water intensive.

organic cotton.notes: Improves on conventional cotton through better farming practices.

recycled polyester.notes: Better than virgin polyester on raw materials, but still sheds microfibres.

polyester.notes: Cheap and resilient, but fossil-based and poor at end of life.

acrylic.notes: Low-cost synthetic often associated with pilling and short lifespan.

nylon.notes: Durable synthetic, but high fossil-fuel dependency and disposal issues.

linen.notes: Lower-input natural fibre with solid durability when well cared for.

viscose.notes: Can vary widely depending on sourcing and chemical controls.
